# Cloud Egress Cost Calculator

> Compare monthly S3-compatible storage, request, and data egress costs for a real workload. Free, private, and runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
